## [0.32.0] - 2026-09-17

Settings panels stop leading with a wall of text.

### Changed

- **A setting description longer than about two lines is now collapsed behind a Show more toggle**, so the control it explains is visible without scrolling past it. This covers Settings > AI agents (MCP) - the card, category and per-tool descriptions - and every engine settings category. Shorter descriptions are shown in full as before.
